03 / DATA MODEL

Two business processes. One safe point to join.

Read the model from left to right: dimensions describe the business, facts record events at their natural grain, and marts combine them only after pickup activity reaches route-day grain.

MODELING PRINCIPLE

Grain before joins.

A pickup is one attempted customer stop. A route day is one operating shift. They become compatible only after pickups are grouped to the route-day-truck key.

SAFE KPIcost_per_stop = Σ total_cost / Σ completed_stops
✕ WRONG

620 pickups × 1 cost row

The same route-day cost would be repeated 620 times.
✓ CORRECT

1 pickup rollup + 1 cost row

The join stays one-to-one at route-day-truck grain.

THE DECISION QUESTION

Which routes cost the most per stop—and what could we save?

All ratios are calculated once using sum-over-sum. Routes are compared only with the median of their own service line.
